verticals.federal_floor: FTC Section 5 · FTC algorithmic-pricing guidance (2023) · FTC Operation AI Comply (2024) · EU Omnibus Directive 2019/2161 Art 6a (personalized-pricing disclosure) · EU AI Act high-risk Annex III · CCPA / CPRA · CA CPPA ADMT regulations · NY S365A ATBP (in-comm) · CA SB-892 · BIPA 740 ILCS 14 + 2024 SB 2979 amendment · NYC §22-1201 (biometric) · PCI DSS 4.0 · GLBA Safeguards (retail-finance overlap)
verticals.key_innovation: TWO retail-specific invariants on audit stream (personalized-pricing-transparency-disclosure-required + biometric-consent-artifact-required); BIPA per-scan-stacking remediation context (post-SB 2979); CPPA ADMT regulations as a state-level enforcement vector beyond FTC Section 5; ADMT opt-out + Global Privacy Control honor records in audit stream; biometric template special retention envelope (365-day BIPA-aligned hard-delete).
